@@U04364@@
and your evil Empire.
Consider:
he has never forgotten your first act as Emperor,
when on your coronation day you freed
from the flames that nefarious sorcerer,
a deed done to the detriment of all Christendom.
It is now for you to beat your breast,
to be penitent and give to a holy cause
a modest mite of your ill-gotten fortune.
That expanse of hills where you pitched your tent,
where evil forces conspired with you for your safety,
where you turned your ear to the Prince of Lies—
give that land with its mountains and forests,
its high, green meadows for grazing,
its clear lakes well stocked with fish, and the waters
that wind and plunge to the valley,
and the valley itself
with its meadows, fields, and dales—
give this in piety as penance to the Church and
find yourself again in the state of grace.

@@U04366@@
My offence horrifies me so deeply,
I leave it to you to determine the boundaries.

@@U04368@@
But, first, to cleanse that place so defiled by sin,
it must at once be rededicated to the Most High.
In my mind's eye I see strong walls rising,
the early morning sun lighting the choir,
the transept next, the nave extending, rising
to the joy of all the faithful.
Already I see them thronging through the noble portals,
the first bell has just tolled over hill and dale,
booming from lofty towers that strive heavenward,
drawing the penitent to a life renewed.
On that day of consecration, Sire—
may it come soon!—
your presence will be its highest ornament.
translation:
@@U04364@@
还有你们邪恶的帝国。
考虑：
他永远不会忘记你作为皇帝的第一个举动，
当你在加冕日获释时
从邪恶巫师的火焰中，
这是一种损害整个基督教世界的行为。
现在该你捶胸顿足了，
悔罪并奉献给神圣的事业
你的不义之财中的一小部分。
你搭帐篷的那片广阔的山丘，
邪恶势力为了你的安全与你合谋，
你把耳朵转向谎言王子——
给予那片土地及其山脉和森林，
其高高的、绿色的草地可供放牧，
清澈的湖泊里盛产鱼类，水域
那风吹向山谷，
和山谷本身
及其草地、田野和山谷——
虔诚地将此作为对教会的忏悔，
发现自己再次处于恩典状态。

@@U04366@@
我的冒犯让我深深感到恐惧，
我把界限留给你来确定。

@@U04368@@
但是，首先要净化那个被罪恶玷污的地方，
它必须立即重新献给至高者。
在我的脑海中我看到坚固的墙壁升起，
清晨的阳光照亮了唱诗班，
接下来是耳堂，中殿延伸、上升
为所有信徒的喜乐。
我已经看到他们涌入高贵的大门，
第一声钟声刚刚敲响漫山遍野，
从高耸入云的塔楼中蓬勃发展，
吸引悔罪者重获新生。
在祝圣的那天，陛下——
愿它快点到来！——
你的存在将是它最高的装饰品。
